Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. How do I sign up for StarHub Prepaid?

Visit any StarHub Authorised Reseller or 7-Eleven store with your original ID document to sign up. Once registered, you can easily manage your plan via the StarHub App.

2. Am I eligible for the Prepaid plan? What do I need to prepare before buying the Prepaid plans?

You can sign up for a Prepaid plan if you are 15 years old and above. 

Please bring along an original form of verification with you (e.g. NRIC, ONE Pass, Employment Pass, S Pass, Work Permit, Student Pass, Dependent Pass or Long Term Visit Pass).

3. Can I port in my mobile number from another operator to StarHub Prepaid?

Yes, you can.  Simply visit any StarHub Authorised Reseller with your original document ID to sign up.

4. I am already using StarHub Prepaid service. Can I sign up for the new StarHub Prepaid Plan and continue using the same number?

Yes, you can change your prepaid plan to our new Prepaid Lite, Prepaid Core, Prepaid Plus, Prepaid Max  4G Prepaid, Prepaid Core & Prepaid Plus, and the change will take effect on your next renewal date.

When submitting a change plan request, you may choose to retain or remove your existing add-ons. Simply go the StarHub app and select Mobile Dashboard > tap "Change Plan.

  • To enjoy the new benefits, existing customers need to change plan.
  • Not valid for customers registered with a passport.


Note that any existing promotions or discounts will be removed once the plan takes effect, and you will not be able to switch back to your old plan.

5. How do I check my usage, balance and manage my account?

You can easily do this via the StarHub App. Simply login with your mobile number.
